answer.explanation: The live CrudApi function has ReservedConcurrentExecutions=1, but the SAM template declares no reserved concurrency for it, so this is an out-of-band configuration drift. CloudWatch shows non-zero Throttles on the CrudApi function in every minute of the window (about 3 to 10 per minute, roughly 50 total), while Errors are zero and the logs contain no error or throttle messages. A concurrency cap of 1 is consistent with that throttling under load. The commits 24f3656 and ca30e64 touched only the TABLE_NAME environment variable (24f3656 set it to a bogus value, and ca30e64 reverted it); the live TABLE_NAME is correct, so they are listed only as recent CrudApi changes, not as the cause.
